sidebar.tun_help: Toggle TUN inbound at runtime (does not modify your config file)

tun_dialog.title: TUN mode needs elevated privileges
tun_dialog.linux_body: Inkwing needs to grant CAP_NET_ADMIN to the bundled sing-box binary so it can open the TUN device. Click Grant to authorise via PolicyKit (one-time setup — future TUN sessions won't ask).
tun_dialog.windows_body: TUN mode requires Administrator on Windows. Inkwing will close and re-open elevated; Windows will show a UAC prompt. Your library and settings are preserved; the current page state will reset.
tun_dialog.macos_body: macOS requires admin authorisation to manage TUN network devices. Touch ID or your password will be requested. Note: macOS re-prompts every time sing-box restarts (mode/config changes, app launch). A signed build with NetworkExtension entitlement will eventually fix this.

settings.title: Settings
settings.minimize_to_tray_desc: When enabled, closing the window hides it to the system tray instead of quitting. Use the tray menu's Quit to exit fully.
settings.autostart_desc: Adds Inkwing to your OS auto-start.
settings.test_url_desc: URL the Proxies page hits when testing node latency. Should respond fast (HTTP/204 or similar). Default uses Google's gstatic generate_204.
settings.accent_desc: Changes button / active-marker / focus-ring colour. Surfaces stay neutral.
settings.language_note: Sidebar / settings labels are translated; deeper page strings will migrate over time.
